description:
The plot illustrates the relationship between epoch and Word Error Rate (WER) for different model configurations. The x-axis is labeled "epoch" and has a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 6 with tick labels at integer values. The y-axis is labeled "WER" and has a linear scale, ranging from 25 to 42.5 with tick labels at intervals of 2.5. 

The first line, colored orange with circular markers, represents "small AdaLoRA_int4". It begins at approximately WER 36 at epoch 0, increases to a peak of approximately WER 41.5 at epoch 1, then declines to approximately WER 31 at epoch 6. The second line, colored orange with square markers, represents "small AdaLoRA_int8". It starts at approximately WER 30 at epoch 0, decreases to approximately WER 27 at epoch 2, then declines to approximately WER 25.5 at epoch 6. The third line, colored yellow with circular markers, represents "small int4". It begins at approximately WER 33 at epoch 0, decreases to approximately WER 28 at epoch 3, then declines to approximately WER 26 at epoch 6. The fourth line, colored yellow with square markers, represents "-". It starts at approximately WER 31 at epoch 0 and declines to approximately WER 26 at epoch 6.
